g.text: BrewLite A2 — Domain model: ingredient inventory and order snapshots
Product.stock used only for legacy orders (marker false).
Public stock = ingredient capacity for S without toppings.
Client choices are validated; server recomputes prices.
Exactly one selector: productId+size OR topping.
Empty/missing base or no tracked base line is unavailable.
Composite key: orderId + ingredientId; aggregate ALL cart lines.
New orders: inventoryTracked = true; reserve snapshot atomically.
Success consumes onHand and reserved exactly once.
Failure keeps reservations; owner cancel releases reserved once.
Recipe edits never modify snapshots; legacy false has no snapshot.
BR-05: replay SUCCESS only for the same owner,
orderId, idempotency key and method; FAILED permits retry.
BR-10: at most one PENDING per order (partial unique index).
provider: VNPAY; pre-VNPay rows retain SIMULATOR.
QueryDR reuses the exact signed gatewayCreateDate.
EXPIRED is a response code; refunds (FR-26) are Won't.
Card details are entered on VNPay and never stored here.
Canonical unit values: g, ml, piece (stored as String).
Only tracked ingredients limit cups or enter snapshots.
Water / ice are unlimited; HTTP quantities are decimal strings.
kind values: RECEIVE or ADJUST (stored as String).
RECEIVE adds stock; ADJUST sets the counted onHand.
Stored quantity is the signed delta; onHandAfter >= reserved.
Manual balance updates and audit rows share one transaction.
FR-17 is Won't: no Promotion table or runtime API.
Order.promotionId and discountAmount are domain only.
